response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.cnt FROM counts c, stats s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(a.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(a.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above a, stats s;
